newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan teenager stabs self in front of crowd.
newsitem.headline: Japan teenager stabs self in front of crowd.

text.p: A 16-year-old male student committed harakiri suicide on Sunday in front of a railway station watched by 200 people, Japan's Kyodo news agency reported.
Quoting police sources, Kyodo said the youth, dressed in his high school uniform, thrust a sword into his torso in the town of Fukushima, about 300 kilometres (200 miles) north of Tokyo.
"According to witnesses, the boy removed his upper clothing and assumed what appeared to be a praying pose before stabbing himself without saying a word," Kyodo said.
The boy, who died from loss of blood, left what appeared to be a suicide note. Its contents were not disclosed.
